_provenance: experimenter-supplied, declared from the published ARA layout before any audit of this arm. Unlike the other two arms this one ships a format specification, so the declaration is a reading of that specification rather than a guess.
_independence: A THIRD source: different authors, different capture, different release. The first two arms are two slices of one corpus (MLR-Bench) and a reviewer is entitled to count them as one.
_why_this_arm: ARA is designed to be auditable, so it is the constructive test of the validity domain rather than another sample of the failure. logic/claims.md is an explicit claim listing -- face C of the recording contract, already implemented -- and evidence/tables/*.md records results as data. If the construction does not work here it does not work anywhere.
_claim_side: logic/claims.md. PAPER.md is a summary carrying almost no numerals; in this format the marked claims are where the assertions live, which is the point of the format.

excluded_rationale.logic/claims.md: the claim side, not the artifact side
excluded_rationale.trace/exploration_tree.yaml: search trace, not a reportable aggregate
